name: Norma Health
statusNote: Norma Health is in App Store review. This page will link to the App Store as soon as the app is available.
headline: Food, workouts and weight, on one clear screen.
summary: Log meals in a couple of taps, record workouts and walks, and follow your weight against a goal you set.
description: Norma Health keeps the day simple: what you ate, how you moved, and whether you are on pace. It is a personal health log for iPhone, built for everyday use.

features.title: Your day at a glance
features.body: Today brings food, movement and weight together. See what you have eaten so far, how much of your plan is left, and your weight trend, all on one screen.

features.title: Meals by day and by week
features.body: Breakfast, lunch, dinner and snacks, each with calories and protein. A week of bars shows how the days compare with your budget.

features.title: Logging that remembers you
features.body: Recent foods, favorites and the meals you have built are ready when you open the log. Pick one, adjust the portion if you need to, and you are done.

features.title: More than 5,000 foods
features.body: Search a catalog of everyday foods, or build a meal from its ingredients and keep it for next time. Your own meals appear first.

features.title: Workouts and walks
features.body: Record walks, rides and runs, or start a strength routine from the built-in exercise library. Activity shows your minutes for the week and the sessions still to go.

features.title: Weight against your plan
features.body: A 7-day average smooths out daily swings. The chart shows where you are, where your plan expects you to be, and when you are on pace to reach your goal.

privacy: No ads, no tracking and no selling of your data. Export everything or delete your account at any time from inside the app.
disclaimer: Norma Health is a planning aid, not medical advice. Talk to a doctor before changing your diet or exercise.
